updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their messaging infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Role Management Enhancements
updates.summary: A new view-only role is being added to Purview and Entra to let admins see all role member assignments across Purview and Defender portals without granting modification rights. This permission is being integrated into Global Reader and Security Reader roles for better auditing and compliance visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Admin Assignment Time Limit
updates.summary: Purview now allows admins to set expiration dates when assigning users and security groups to role groups, enabling temporary privilege delegation with automatic revocation. This feature strengthens just-in-time access controls for compliance and security governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey Support for B2B Users
updates.summary: B2B users can now register and use passkeys issued by a resource tenant to satisfy MFA requirements, extending passwordless authentication beyond member users. This enables stronger, more convenient authentication for external and guest users collaborating in your tenant.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Inactive Accounts
updates.summary: Purview is automating the deletion of content and containers for departed employees' inactive OneDrives and mailboxes at scale, eliminating manual cleanup and reducing compliance risk. This helps organizations maintain regulatory compliance without ongoing administrative overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Cloud Attachments Preservation for Users on Hold
updates.summary: Purview now preserves file versions shared as cloud attachments for users placed on infinite legal hold, ensuring compliance across OneDrive and SharePoint sites. This extends eDiscovery and compliance protections to modern cloud-native sharing patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer, blocking risky cloud applications and enforcing DLP policies across browsers, apps, and AI platforms. This prevents data exfiltration through less-controlled channels and provides Insider Risk Management visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Compliance Report
updates.summary: Admins can now generate compliance reports in Information Barriers to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and embedded containers that violate policy after changes. This simplifies remediation and audit workflows for information barrier governance.
